correctness.rationale: For prescribed vector norms, independent convex endpoint selection reduces the objective to projective sign rows. At most m classes can be represented, giving the two-level sharp upper envelope; a minimum-weight-coordinate flip pairing attains it because the missing count is at most half. Cauchy equality reduces arbitrary weights to (a,...,a,b); a feasible top eigenvector of a 2×2 symmetric matrix proves the exact universal quotient. Exact rational exhaustive small cases and an algebraic five-coordinate witness check critical steps; these finite checks are supplementary.
